name: history-jul-to-apr-9-month-transition
description: A fixed-date calendar that changes from 1 July to 1 April years through a nine-month transition year, 2024-07-01 to 2025-03-31, split into three quarters of three calendar months (exceptions.history with a calendar_months transition). The dates are those of research/filers/pg-hygiene.md; the quarter split, weeks and the period and week templates are illustrative. Numbered by 'start', the years run 2023, 2024 (the transition), 2025 with no skip, and {yy_end} gives '2024-25' for the transition. Covers the transition's quarters, periods and 40 weeks (week 40 is 2025-03-31 alone), LEVEL_NOT_NESTED for weeks of a calendar_months transition quarter, shift across both changes, out-of-range indexes inside the transition, labels and parse (a {yy_end} that disagrees with the year's last day is LABEL_NOT_RECOGNISED), and dimension rows across the end of the transition.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
